app.tagline: Hebrew, English and five more languages, spoken in your browser. First audio in about 80 ms, and nothing you type leaves the tab.
app.buffering: buffering, this device is slower than real time

status.done: first audio in {{first}} ms, {{seconds}}s of audio in {{elapsed}}s, {{speed}}× real time
status.tooShort: too short, try five seconds or so

loader.intro: The model runs on your machine, so it has to get there first. It is cached after this, and nothing you type ever leaves the page.
loader.introCached: Already on this machine, so there is nothing to fetch. Nothing you type ever leaves the page.

share.intro: A link back to this page. With the text in it, whoever opens it lands on this language, this voice and these words.
share.withTextHint: The words in the box, the language and the voice.
share.cloned: A cloned voice stays in the tab it was made in, so the link carries the language's own voice instead.

debug.empty: Generate something and this is the text as the model received it: the phonemes it was given, and the tokens they became.

snippets.noteInstall: then take a model from the releases and put it beside your script
snippets.noteHebrew: renikud adds the vowels and is fetched on first use; nikud and IPA pass through as typed
snippets.noteSame: the same weights this page is running, on onnxruntime alone

voice.intro: Pick one, or make your own from a few seconds of audio.
voice.dropHint: Five to ten seconds of clear speech is plenty
voice.cloneHint: wav, mp3, ogg, flac · up to 40 MB
voice.dropTitle: Drop an audio file here, or record one
voice.listening: Listening — speak for five to ten seconds
voice.consent: Only clone voices you have permission to use. Never to impersonate someone.

download.title: {{language}} is a separate model
download.body: {{language}} has a model of its own, about {{size}} MB. It is fetched once and kept in the browser's cache after that.

settings.temperatureHint: Low is flat and safe, high is lively; past 0.6 it starts to stumble.
settings.stepsHint: More refines each frame. The speed is the same whichever you pick.
settings.showTokensHint: The text as the model received it, under each take.
settings.normalizeHint: Every voice at the same level. This one does change the download.
